On November 2, 2026, Grindr Inc. (the “Company”) issued a press release announcing the completion of the Company’s acquisition of PurposeMed Inc. (“PurposeMed”), as described in Item 8.01 below. A copy of the press release is attached as Exhibit 99.1 to this Current Report on Form 8-K and is incorporated herein by reference. The information contained herein and the accompanying Exhibit 99.1 is being furnished under “Item 7.01 Regulation FD Disclosure” and shall not be deemed “filed” for purposes of Section 18 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended, or otherwise subject to the liabilities of that section or Sections 11 and 12(a)(2) of the Securities Act of 1933, as amended, nor shall it be deemed incorporated by reference in any filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission made by the Company, whether made before or after the date hereof, regardless of any general incorporation language in such filing. Item 8.01 Other Events. On November 2, 2026, the Company completed the previously announced acquisition of PurposeMed pursuant to that certain Securities Purchase Agreement, dated September 30, 2026 (the “Purchase Agreement”), by and among the Company, 18273618 Canada Inc., a Canadian corporation and wholly owned subsidiary of the Company, PurposeMed, the shareholders of PurposeMed party thereto (the “Sellers”), and Dr. Husein Moloo, solely in his capacity as the Sellers’ representative. Pursuant to the terms and subject to the conditions set forth in the Purchase Agreement, the Company acquired all of the issued and outstanding shares of PurposeMed for an upfront purchase price of approximately $250.0 million, subject to customary purchase price adjustments, consisting of $190.0 million in cash and $60.0 million in shares of the Company’s common stock, par value $0.0001 per share (an aggregate of 3,851,684 shares). Pursuant to the terms and subject to the conditions set forth in the Purchase Agreement, the Sellers are also eligible to receive additional earnout consideration of up to $70.0 million in cash, contingent on the PurposeMed business achieving certain financial performance targets for the fiscal year ending December 31, 2027.
